# SCNet Token Plan for Magpie [简体中文](README.md) Connects your [SCNet (超算互联网) Token Plan](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html) to [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai). Sign in on SCNet's website in your browser; the plugin picks up the account, its existing plan key, the plan's models and the Credits left, and every agent in Magpie can use those models. - Browser sign-in on SCNet's official page that finishes by itself; no key or cookie to copy - Accounts show as "超算互联网 · user · plan", with Credits left, a usage bar and the plan's end date - Several accounts, and removal of old ones from within the plugin - Streaming and tool calls; Magpie carries OpenAI Chat, Responses and Anthropic Messages clients to SCNet An independent MIT-licensed community project, not an official SCNet or Magpie plugin. *Example screenshot of a manually configured demo account with demo balances. Browser sign-in names accounts "超算互联网 · user · plan".* ## Install In Magpie open **Plugins → Discover**, search for `scnet`, `超算` or `超算互联网`, and install `scnet-auth` from the **Unofficial, on GitHub** section. That section lists plugins their authors publish on GitHub; Magpie has not reviewed them. Or from the command line: ```sh magpie plugin add github:bbingz/scnet-auth ``` **Updating:** open **Plugins → Installed** and press **Update** on `scnet-auth`. An update reloads the plugin host, so do it while no agent is mid-request. ## Sign in (recommended: browser, macOS) 1. Follow Magpie's prompt after installing, or open **Providers**: - first account: **Add a provider → From plugins → 超算互联网 · SCNet Token Plan** - more accounts: **Add another … account** on that provider 2. Choose **浏览器登录超算互联网（macOS 官网）**. Magpie opens SCNet's official login page in your default browser. Password, SMS and QR sign-in all work, and an existing website session is fine too. 3. When macOS asks for Keychain access, press **Allow**. The plugin needs it to decrypt the browser's SCNet session. 4. Wait. It usually finishes within a few seconds to half a minute (the browser writes its session to disk with a short delay); the account, models and Credits then appear in Magpie. Notes: - Supported: Chrome (including Beta/Dev/Canary), Edge and Brave on macOS, as the **default browser**, in a normal window. Private windows can't be read. Only Chrome Beta has been tried with a real account so far. - Whatever SCNet account the browser is signed in to is the one connected. To use another, sign out or switch on SCNet first, then start the browser sign-in again. - Signing in again with the same user and plan updates that account rather than adding a second one. - With no session after five minutes the attempt times out and saves nothing. On Windows, Linux, Safari or a machine without a desktop, use manual setup. ## Manual setup (Windows / Linux / Safari / headless) Choose **手动配置 API Key（高级 / 无桌面环境）** and answer the wizard: | Step | What to enter | | --- | --- | | Account label | e.g. 主账号, shown as "超算互联网 · 主账号". Signing in again with the same label updates that account. | | Models | **Event** for the DeepSeek event plan (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Event`); otherwise **custom**, with the exact model IDs from your console, separated by commas or new lines. | | Credits | **连接额度查询** to show Credits, or **暂不查询额度** to skip. | | Console cookie | Only when showing Credits; see below. | | Plan | The plan your API key belongs to. | | API key | The plan's own key from the Token Plan page (starts with `sk-tp-`). A pay-as-you-go key doesn't draw on plan Credits. |
Getting the console cookie (manual setup only) 1. Sign in to the [Token Plan console](https://www.scnet.cn/ui/console/index.html#/llm/token-plan). 2. Open developer tools (`⌥⌘I` on macOS, `F12` elsewhere) → **Network**. 3. Reload and filter for `tokenplan/list`. 4. Open that request and copy the **value** of its `Cookie` request header (no `Cookie:` prefix, not `Set-Cookie`, not a whole cURL command). 5. Paste it into the wizard's masked field. A cookie is a login credential: keep it out of issues, chats and screenshots.
## Models - Browser sign-in uses the models included in your plan. - Pick `scnet-token-plan/` in an agent, e.g. `scnet-token-plan/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Event`. - Only your plan's models are listed, not SCNet's whole catalog. - SCNet publishes no context or output limits, so none are set (shown as 0, unspecified). ## Credits Each account shows Credits left, used/total, a percentage and the plan's end date. - Credits are SCNet's per-model conversion, not tokens. - Credits are read for the plan chosen at sign-in. If you **buy a new plan** after one runs out, sign in through the browser again to follow it. - A failed Credits read (expired website session, network) only affects the display, never model requests. Signing in again restores it. ## Removing an account 1. Open the SCNet provider and press **Add another … account**. 2. Choose **管理已保存账号（移除旧 KEY）** and pick the account. 3. Check its name or key ending and press **确认移除这个账号**. Cancel before that removes nothing. 4. After 「已移除」, press Cancel to close, then reopen the provider. Only Magpie's local record is removed; SCNet's key and your other accounts are untouched. The first and the last account can both be removed. To remove every account, or the plugin itself: ```sh magpie plugin logout scnet-token-plan magpie plugin rm github:bbingz/scnet-auth ``` ## Troubleshooting **Not found in the market?** Search under **Plugins → Discover**; it is in the **Unofficial, on GitHub** section. Magpie caches the GitHub list for about ten minutes; if the section says some plugins couldn't be read, press **Try again**. **Browser sign-in never finishes?** Make sure you signed in with the **default** browser, in a normal window, and that it is a supported one; allow the Keychain prompt. Manual setup always works. **The wrong account was connected?** The plugin connects the account the browser is signed in to. Switch accounts on SCNet, sign in again, then remove the one you don't want. **Credits say the console session expired?** SCNet's website session ended. Sign in through the browser again; model requests are unaffected. **401 / 403 / 429 from requests?** Check whether the plan has ended or run out of Credits, and that the model ID is exact (case, date and `-Event` suffix). SCNet's errors reach Magpie unchanged so it can retry or switch accounts. **Usage terms.** SCNet allows a Token Plan only for the subscriber's own interactive use in AI tools, not for scripts, app backends or batch calls, and may ban keys that break this. See [SCNet's terms](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html). ## Privacy and security - **Read:** only `scnet.cn` cookies from the default browser's last-used profile, filtered by host and path inside a read-only database query. No other profile is scanned, the cookie database isn't copied, and other sites, passwords and history aren't read. The Keychain secret lives only in memory for the attempt and is cleared after. - **Stored:** the plan key, SCNet console session, plan ID and model list, in Magpie's credential file `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json` (or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/magpie/plugin-auth.json`). - **Sent:** model requests only to `https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1/chat/completions`; the console session only to fixed `https://www.scnet.cn` query URLs. Neither follows redirects, and neither is sent to the other. - **Never:** creates or resets keys, buys plans, or changes browser or system security settings. ## Technical details | Item | Value | | --- | --- | | Provider ID | `scnet-token-plan` | | Model base URL | `https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1` | | Credits endpoint | `https://www.scnet.cn/acx/charge/account/currentuser/tokenplan/list` (an internal console API that may change) | | Runtime | Magpie's bundled Bun; Node.js ≥ 22.13 when run standalone | See [docs/quota-api.md](docs/quota-api.md) for how sign-in and Credits work. The plugin uses Magpie's OpenCode plugin interface and hasn't been tried in OpenCode itself. ## Development ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test # unit tests npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts # macOS with Magpie and Bun installed: real Magpie against a mock SCNet, isolated SCNET_TEST_BUN=/absolute/path/to/bun npm run test:magpie ``` The integration run uses temporary directories, fake credentials and a macOS sandbox. It never reads or changes your Magpie accounts and never calls the real SCNet. ## References - [SCNet Token Plan](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html) - [Magpie plugin guide](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/plugins) - [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

# 超算互联网 · SCNet Token Plan（Magpie 插件） [English](README.en.md) 把你的[超算互联网 Token Plan](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html)接入 [Magpie](https://usemagpie.ai)。在浏览器里登录 SCNet 官网，插件自动读取账号、现有套餐 Key、套餐模型和剩余 Credits，Magpie 里的各个 Agent 就能直接使用这些模型。 - 浏览器登录：用 SCNet 官方登录页，登录后自动完成，不用复制 Key 或 Cookie - 账号显示为「超算互联网 · 用户名 · 套餐名」，带剩余 Credits、用量进度和到期时间 - 支持多个账号，可在插件内移除旧账号 - 流式输出和工具调用；Magpie 负责把 OpenAI Chat、Responses、Anthropic Messages 协议转发给 SCNet 社区开源项目（MIT），不是 SCNet 或 Magpie 官方插件。 *示例截图：手动配置的演示账号，余额为演示数据。浏览器登录的账号名为「超算互联网 · 用户名 · 套餐名」。* ## 安装 在 Magpie 打开 **插件 → 发现**，搜索「超算」「超算互联网」或「scnet」，在「非官方插件 · GitHub」区找到 `scnet-auth`，点 **安装**。这个区域列的是作者自行发布到 GitHub 的插件，未经 Magpie 官方审核。 也可以用命令行： ```sh magpie plugin add github:bbingz/scnet-auth ``` **更新：** 打开 **插件 → 已安装**，在 `scnet-auth` 上点 **更新**。更新会重新加载插件进程，建议在没有 Agent 正在请求时进行。 ## 登录（推荐：浏览器登录，macOS） 1. 安装后按 Magpie 的提示登录；或打开 **供应商**： - 第一次添加：**添加供应商 → 来自插件 → 超算互联网 · SCNet Token Plan** - 已有账号：在该供应商里点 **添加另一个 … 账号** 2. 选择 **浏览器登录超算互联网（macOS 官网）**。Magpie 会在默认浏览器打开 SCNet 官方登录页，用账号密码、短信或扫码登录都可以；浏览器里已经登录过的也行。 3. macOS 弹出「钥匙串访问」提示时，点 **允许**。插件需要用它解密浏览器里的 SCNet 登录状态。 4. 等待自动完成。通常几秒到半分钟（浏览器把登录状态写入磁盘需要一点时间），之后 Magpie 里就会出现账号、模型和剩余 Credits。 说明： - 支持 macOS 上的 Chrome（含 Beta / Dev / Canary）、Edge、Brave，要求是**默认浏览器**的普通窗口，无痕窗口的登录读不到。目前只用 Chrome Beta 做过真实账号验证。 - 浏览器里登录的是哪个 SCNet 账号，就连接哪个。要换账号，先在官网退出或切换，再重新发起浏览器登录。 - 同一用户、同一套餐再次登录，会更新原来的账号，不会重复添加。 - 五分钟内没读到登录结果会超时，不保存任何内容。 Windows、Linux、Safari 或没有桌面环境时，用下面的手动配置。 ## 手动配置（Windows / Linux / Safari / 无桌面） 选择 **手动配置 API Key（高级 / 无桌面环境）**，按向导填写： | 步骤 | 怎么填 | | --- | --- | | 账号备注 | 例如「主账号」，显示为「超算互联网 · 主账号」。同名备注再次登录会更新原账号。 | | 模型配置 | DeepSeek 活动套餐选 **Event**（模型 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Event`）；其他套餐选 **自定义**，填写控制台里的完整模型 ID，用逗号或换行分隔。 | | 剩余额度 | 想显示 Credits 选 **连接额度查询**，否则选 **暂不查询额度**。 | | 控制台 Cookie | 仅在连接额度查询时需要，获取方法见下方。 | | 套餐 | 选与你的 API Key 对应的套餐。 | | API Key | Token Plan 页面的专属 Key（以 `sk-tp-` 开头）。普通按量付费 Key 不能抵扣套餐额度。 |
如何获取控制台 Cookie（仅手动配置需要） 1. 在浏览器登录 [Token Plan 控制台](https://www.scnet.cn/ui/console/index.html#/llm/token-plan)。 2. 打开开发者工具（macOS `⌥⌘I`，Windows / Linux `F12`），切到 **Network / 网络**。 3. 刷新页面，在请求列表里筛选 `tokenplan/list`。 4. 点开这个请求，在 **Request Headers / 请求标头** 里复制 `Cookie` 的**值**（不要带 `Cookie:` 前缀，也不要复制 `Set-Cookie` 或整段 cURL）。 5. 粘贴到向导里的遮罩输入框。 Cookie 相当于登录凭据，不要发到 Issue、聊天或截图里。
## 模型 - 浏览器登录：自动使用该套餐包含的模型。 - 在 Agent 里选择 `scnet-token-plan/<模型 ID>`，例如 `scnet-token-plan/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Event`。 - 插件只列出你的套餐包含的模型，不会把 SCNet 平台上的全部模型都加进来。 - SCNet 没有公布上下文和输出长度上限，插件不设置（显示为 0，即未指定）。 ## 剩余额度 账号下会显示剩余 Credits、已用 / 总额、用量百分比和套餐到期时间。 - Credits 由 SCNet 按模型折算，不等于 token 数。 - 额度查询绑定登录时选中的套餐。套餐用完后**新买了套餐**，请重新浏览器登录一次，额度才会切换到新套餐。 - 额度查询失败（会话过期、网络问题等）只影响额度显示，不影响模型调用。重新浏览器登录即可恢复。 ## 移除账号 1. 打开「超算互联网」供应商，点 **添加另一个 … 账号**。 2. 选择 **管理已保存账号（移除旧 KEY）**，再选要移除的账号。 3. 核对名称或 Key 尾号，点 **确认移除这个账号**。确认前点「取消」不会删除任何东西。 4. 看到「已移除」后点「取消」关闭，再重新打开供应商查看。 这里只删除 Magpie 本机保存的这条记录，不会撤销 SCNet 官网的 Key，也不影响其他账号。第一个和最后一个账号都可以移除。 移除全部账号或卸载插件： ```sh magpie plugin logout scnet-token-plan magpie plugin rm github:bbingz/scnet-auth ``` ## 常见问题 **市场里搜不到？** 确认在 **插件 → 发现** 里搜索，结果在「非官方插件 · GitHub」区。Magpie 会缓存 GitHub 列表约十分钟；如果该区提示有插件没能读取，点 **重试**。 **浏览器登录一直没完成，最后超时？** 确认登录的是**默认浏览器**、普通窗口，且是上面支持的浏览器；钥匙串提示需要点 **允许**。仍不行可以用手动配置。 **连接成了另一个账号？** 插件连接的是浏览器当前登录的 SCNet 账号。在官网切换账号后重新登录，再用「移除账号」删掉不需要的那个。 **额度显示「控制台会话已失效」？** SCNet 网页登录过期了。重新浏览器登录即可，模型调用不受影响。 **请求返回 401 / 403 / 429？** 检查套餐是否到期或额度用完，以及模型 ID 是否完整（大小写、日期和 `-Event` 后缀都要一致）。SCNet 的错误会原样交给 Magpie，方便它重试或切换账号。 **使用限制** SCNet 规定 Token Plan 仅限本人在 AI 工具中交互式使用，不能用于自动化脚本、应用后端或批量调用，违规可能导致 Key 被封。详见[官方说明](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html)。 ## 隐私与安全 - **读取什么：** 只读访问默认浏览器最近使用的那个资料里 `scnet.cn` 的 Cookie，在数据库查询阶段就限定域名和路径。不扫描其他资料，不复制整个 Cookie 数据库，不读其他网站、密码或浏览记录。钥匙串里的解密密钥只在本次登录的内存中使用，结束即清除。 - **保存什么：** 套餐 Key、SCNet 控制台会话、套餐 ID 和模型列表，保存在 Magpie 的凭据文件 `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json`（或 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/magpie/plugin-auth.json`）。 - **发往哪里：** 模型请求只发到 `https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1/chat/completions`；控制台会话只发到 `https://www.scnet.cn` 的固定查询地址。两者都不跟随重定向，也不会混用。 - **不会做：** 创建或重置 Key、购买套餐、修改浏览器或系统的安全设置。 ## 技术信息 | 项目 | 值 | | --- | --- | | Provider ID | `scnet-token-plan` | | 模型 Base URL | `https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1` | | 额度接口 | `https://www.scnet.cn/acx/charge/account/currentuser/tokenplan/list`（控制台内部接口，可能随网站更新变化） | | 运行环境 | Magpie 内置 Bun；独立运行需 Node.js ≥ 22.13 | 登录和额度的实现细节见 [docs/quota-api.md](docs/quota-api.md)。插件按 Magpie 的 OpenCode 插件接口编写，未在原生 OpenCode 中验证。 ## 开发 ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test # 单元测试 npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts # macOS，已安装 Magpie 和 Bun：在隔离环境中跑真实 Magpie + 模拟 SCNet SCNET_TEST_BUN=/absolute/path/to/bun npm run test:magpie ``` 集成测试使用临时目录、假凭据和 macOS 沙箱，不会读取或修改你现有的 Magpie 账号，也不会请求真实的 SCNet。 ## 参考 - [SCNet Token Plan 说明](https://www.scnet.cn/help/docs/mainsite/mass/plans/token-plan.html) - [Magpie 插件指南](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/plugins) - [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

# Changelog

## 0.3.6 — 2026-10-25

- The plugin market card shows SCNet's own mark (the red "SCNet" of its website icon) instead of a generic puzzle piece; it is set in `package.json`'s `magpie.icon`. The provider and its accounts use the same picture in place of the blue "S" drawn for 0.2.0.

## Documentation — 2026-10-25

- Rewrite the Chinese and English READMEs around installing, signing in, Credits and removing accounts, and turn `docs/quota-api.md` into a plain description of how sign-in and Credits work.

## 0.3.5 — 2026-10-25

- Browser sign-in finishes by itself: once SCNet accepts the browser's session, the account, key, plan and models are saved. The local "连接到 Magpie" confirmation page is gone.
- SCNet allows one Token Plan per account, so the plan is chosen automatically: enabled, not expired, with Credits left, ending first. If its models can't be read, sign-in fails and points to manual setup.
- All Token Plan models are marked as supporting reasoning (SCNet lists every one with deep thinking); only DeepSeek models were before.
- Remaining English error text is now Chinese, and the hint for accounts without Credits no longer sends manual users to the macOS browser sign-in.

## 0.3.4 — 2026-10-24

- Add **管理已保存账号（移除旧 KEY）** to the sign-in methods: pick a saved SCNet account and confirm to remove it, including the first or the only one, which Magpie's own account list doesn't offer. Only Magpie's local record is removed.

## 0.3.3 — 2026-10-24

- Open SCNet's desktop login page (the one its homepage uses) instead of the compact mobile-style page.
- Add a Chinese GitHub description so searching 超算 or 超算互联网 in Magpie's plugin market finds the plugin.

## 0.3.2 — 2026-10-24

- Sign in on SCNet's official page in the default browser and read that browser's SCNet session (macOS Chrome, Edge, Brave), with the macOS Keychain prompt. Replaces the local SMS form of 0.3.1.

## 0.3.1 — 2026-10-24

- Sign in through a local SMS page opened in the default browser, replacing the separate browser window of 0.3.0. Remove the Playwright dependency.

## 0.3.0 — 2026-10-24

- Browser sign-in becomes the default: sign in on SCNet in a separate browser window, and the account name, existing key, plan models and Credits are filled in automatically.

## 0.2.0 — 2026-10-24

- Chinese setup wizard with account labels, Event or custom models, and optional Credits through the console cookie.
- Accounts and the provider are named 超算互联网, with their own icon.

## Rename — 2026-10-24

- Rename the package and repository to `scnet-auth` (still 0.1.0). The provider ID stays `scnet-token-plan`, so existing accounts keep working.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-24

- First release: the `scnet-token-plan` provider with API-key sign-in, per-account model IDs (default `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Event`), streaming and tool calls, sending requests only to SCNet's Chat Completions endpoint.

# How sign-in and Credits work

SCNet has no public OAuth or quota API for third-party tools. This plugin reads the SCNet session your own browser already holds and uses the same console endpoints SCNet's web console calls. Those endpoints are internal and may change without notice. Endpoint paths and fields were checked against SCNet's public console bundles on 2026-10-24.

## Endpoints

All console requests go to `https://www.scnet.cn/acx` with the session cookie, a ten-second timeout and `redirect: "error"`. None carries the inference key.

| Request | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /user/users/current-user-info` | User ID and name |
| `GET /charge/account/currentuser/tokenplan/list` | The account's Token Plan subscriptions and their Credits |
| `GET /llm/api-key/token-plan/query` | The existing Token Plan key (read only; never created or reset) |
| `GET /llm/api/package/overview?packageType=TokenPlan` (optionally `&code=`) | The models of a plan, matched by its `resourceId` |

Responses are expected as `{code: "0", data: ...}`. A business code `401`/`403` means signed out; any other shape fails with a Chinese message, without echoing the upstream body. An anonymous request to these paths returns code `401` ("用户未登录").

Source of the paths and fields: the console bundle `https://www.scnet.cn/ui/console/static/js/16.a21f8a46.js` declares `GET /charge/account/currentuser/tokenplan/list` under `/acx`; `68.c5b19b0a.js` renders its total, used and expiry fields; `2938.13931614.js` scopes usage by `resourceAccountId`. The first lead came from [Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan](https://github.com/Ronnie-Young/dsh-scnet-plan/blob/main/docs/scnet-api.md); no code was taken from it.

## Browser sign-in (macOS)

1. Magpie opens `https://www.scnet.cn/ac/api/auth/loginSsoRedirect.action?originalUrl=<Token Plan console>` in the default browser. This is the desktop SSO entry SCNet's homepage uses; the user signs in there, and the plugin never sees a password or code.
2. The plugin asks macOS (NSWorkspace) for the default browser. Chrome (stable, Beta, Dev, Canary), Edge and Brave are supported; anything else gets a message pointing to manual setup.
3. It reads the browser's `Local State` for the last-used profile, and opens only that profile's `Cookies` database, read-only. The SQL selects only rows for `scnet.cn`, `.scnet.cn`, `www.scnet.cn` and `.www.scnet.cn`, on paths `/`, `/acx` or `/acx/`, that are unpartitioned; expired rows are dropped. Other profiles, sites and tables are never read and the database is never copied.
4. If those rows are encrypted, the browser's "Safe Storage" secret is read from the macOS Keychain through the normal authorization prompt. Values are decrypted as Chromium does on macOS (`v10`, AES-128-CBC with a PBKDF2 key, and the host hash check of schema 24+; see [Chromium](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/heads/main/components/os_crypt/sync/os_crypt_mac.mm)). The secret and derived key stay in memory and are cleared when the attempt ends. A refused prompt ends the attempt.
5. Every 2.5 seconds the cookies are read again and checked against the profile endpoint until SCNet accepts them. Then the plan, key and models are read and the account is saved. There is no local page or listener. With no accepted session after five minutes, the attempt times out and nothing is saved.

### Choosing the plan

SCNet allows one Token Plan per account at a time and one key per subscription. The plugin keeps subscriptions that are enabled and not expired, and refuses duplicate IDs. Among those it prefers one with Credits left (an exhausted plan can sit beside a newly bought one), and then the one that ends first. If that plan's models can't be read, from the subscription row or from the catalog by its `resourceId`, sign-in fails and points to manual setup; models are never guessed.

### What is saved

The account is saved as an API-key sign-in with this metadata:

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `email` | `超算互联网 · <user> · <plan>`, the display name; Magpie uses it to update the same account on a later sign-in |
| `scnetUserId` | SCNet user ID |
| `models` | The plan's model IDs, comma-separated |
| `quota`, `consoleCookie`, `quotaPlan` | `console`, the SCNet session cookie, and the plan's `resourceAccountId` |

## Credits

`usage` reads `tokenplan/list` with the saved cookie and takes the one subscription whose `resourceAccountId` equals `quotaPlan`. A missing or duplicated match fails rather than showing another plan.

- Total is the first of `totalAmount`, `All`, `planCredits`, `monthlyCredits`, `totalCredits`; used is the first of `usedAmount`, `used`, `usedCredits`, `consumeCredits`, `consumedCredits`, `consume`, `usage`. Missing, negative, non-numeric or empty values are not read as zero.
- Remaining is `max(total - used, 0)`; usage can exceed 100%.
- Times without a zone are China Standard Time (UTC+08:00). The end date doesn't imply renewal; a reset time is shown only when SCNet returns one.
- An expired or disabled plan is reported as such, not as a balance.
- Every result carries `signIn: "kept"`, so a failed Credits read never marks the inference key as signed out.

Because `quotaPlan` is fixed at sign-in, a plan bought later is followed only after signing in again.

## Inference

The loader allows only `https://api.scnet.cn/api/llm/v1/chat/completions`. It drops any client `Authorization`, `x-api-key`, `cookie` and similar headers, sets the account's current key as a Bearer token, refuses redirects, and passes the body, stream, tool calls and cancellation through unchanged. Magpie translates Responses and Anthropic clients to Chat Completions.

## Why this approach

Earlier versions tried an isolated browser (0.3.0) and a local SMS form (0.3.1); both were rejected in favour of signing in on SCNet's own page in the user's browser (0.3.2). A local confirmation page after sign-in was removed in 0.3.5. SCNet's CAS refused a localhost callback service, and community plugins such as WorkBuddy rely on vendor login-state APIs that SCNet doesn't offer, so reading the browser's own session is the remaining way to finish sign-in without copying cookies.
